collection.title: Hyundai H100 1996 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Hyundai H100 1996 to 2004 model which requires an 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
